data.gender_notes: Jawaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Awd, meaning to return, reward, and restore. The name Jawaad signifies someone who is gentle, kind, and honest, and who strives to restore justice and peace. The name Jawaad carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Honest” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawaad usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, honest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawaad total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
